question: The average of 7 numbers is 25. If each number is decreased by 3, what will the new average be?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If each observation in a data set is decreased by a constant value, the average of the data set also decreases by the same constant value.

Here, every number is decreased by 3.

New Average = Old Average − 3

New Average = 25 − 3 = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**
